Paragraph: "Wiping the tears from his eyes, Raghava looked around Lake Pampa with renewed vigor and clarity..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Transitioning physically and mentally out of an acute crying episode.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama wipes his tears, takes a physical shift, and re-engages with his environment.
Outcome/Resolution: He demonstrates visible somatic and mental recovery from acute distress.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Somatic Reset, Recovery from Distress, Physical Grounding

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Pratibodha (Awakening from emotional haze into clear awareness)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Wiping away tears symbolizes clearing the mist of illusion (Maya) to behold divine duty clearly.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Physiological reset: executing physical actions (wiping tears, surveying surroundings) to ground oneself post-catharsis.
